observations.what: 20 contexts (fund Golub) carry an identifier member naming another company or a mis-spelling (Amberfield for Athenahealth, Eclipse Buyer for Eliassen, YI Inc, LeadsOnline LLC LLC, Movement Holdings with LLC read as instrument, Titan BW without L.P.); the issuer_name_printed rule flagged 17 rows, not YI, LeadsOnline, Movement, Titan
observations.suggested_check: For every published row compare the folded issuer_name with the first cell of the printed row carrying the row's own fair-value context; allow only legal-form punctuation differences; flag any other difference including a missing legal form (L.P., LLC).

detection_decision.rationale: issuer_name_printed fired on 17 of the 42 rows in the untouched baseline but missed the legal-form and doubled-form cases; a strict folded-equality check on the context row would catch all 42 with little false-positive risk.

observations.what: 59 loan and preferred rows printed "SF + 7.50 (h) 11.83 PIK" or "12.50 % Non-Cash" published with interest_rate empty (pik_only_tag_reading needs no spread)
observations.suggested_check: Flag a published row whose printed text contains PIK or Non-Cash next to a rate and whose interest_rate is null.

detection_decision.rationale: No rule fired on these rows in the untouched build (X02 needs a missing spread too, pik_printed fired nowhere for Golub); the shared step is financial_conventions pik_only coupon, which requires no spread.
